initialization: No object pickup. Original Ready reset, open grippers; left moves to its shared goal using original numeric executor. Right stays at its measured Ready TCP.
public_instruction: 无持物共享工位轮换。初态左臂占用共享工位。先让右臂 TCP 在给定的右臂共享目标位姿连续保持至少 0.5 秒，再让左臂 TCP 在给定的左臂共享目标位姿连续保持至少 0.5 秒；结束时右臂回到本回合初始 Ready TCP。双夹爪保持打开，不抓取物体。全程不得互臂接触或碰撞桌面。自主选择退让位置、数值动作、路径及顺序或并行；没有自动让行技能。
order_scoring: Initial left occupancy is not credit. Right dwell must precede a later left dwell; both final left shared goal and right Ready are required.
coupling_check: Attempt right shared goal while left occupies it: unchanged whole-path precheck must reject without execution. Then validate one sequential physical witness. Rejected proposal is a private engineering negative control, never model context.
not_measured: CTAG grasping, object transfer, task optimality, Astra ability
